UK CHAMPIONSHIPS - CWMBRAN - 25/26 MAY: John Regis was continually checking across at the opposition in the final 50m of the 200m and that's a measure of the ease with which he disposed of Todd Bennett and the rest to claim the title in 21.34 into a strong headwind.

At about 3.30 on Saturday afternoon, John Regis lined up alongside Linford Christie, Todd Bennett, Ade Mafe et al for the 200m final; 20.41 seconds later he was punching the air in celebration of a superb win.
John Regis was beaten on the dip by Colin Jackson and Todd Bennett in the 100 and Marcus was given the same treatment in the 200. But the 4x100 recorded a magnificent win in 41.26.

First event for him was the long jump where in a close competition he found Team Solent's Captain Todd Bennett just getting the better of him, but in his speciality, the triple, he comfortably leapt out to 14.68 for an easy 'B' win.
